subject: prd/read-to-rule
statement: The template shall define the read-to-rule section (§0): a human-only routing section placed before §1, comprising four blocks — ranked judgment calls, sanity-check numbers, the author's open questions, and the informed-skip map — together with its tier rule: which tiers carry §0, and the skip form where permitted.
rationale: the section's shape is the product (brainstorm:gate-attention#D-1, #D-2, #D-9)
fit_criterion: the template's §0 contract names placement, all four blocks, the length cap, the selection rule, and the tier rule; an instantiated document missing a required block is nonconformant at its review
